summary: Completed frontend testing of Google Places autocomplete bug fix on ClientPortalPage (/my-booking/:token). The fix (changing REACT_APP_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY to REACT_APP_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY at line 15) is working correctly. All autocomplete features verified on both desktop and mobile viewports.
critical_code_review_comments: Line 15 correctly uses REACT_APP_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY (same as BookingPage.jsx)
Google Maps singleton pattern prevents multiple script loads
Autocomplete properly initialized for both pickup and dropoff fields
Price recalculation triggers correctly after address selection
pac-container z-index already set to 10000 in index.css
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google Places autocomplete is fully working on ClientPortalPage. The bug fix (changing env variable) was verified. Note: Google console shows deprecation warning about google.maps.places.Autocomplete being deprecated for new customers as of March 2025 - recommend migrating to PlaceAutocompleteElement in future updates.
